incident_spec.summary: Concurrent UPDATE statements on a single row in a small table cause significant delays due to locking contention.
symptoms: UPDATE statements take several minutes to complete.
High contention on a single row due to concurrent updates.

incident_spec.mechanism: Row-level locking contention caused by concurrent updates to the same row in a table without indexes.
